items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Enable caching of role prices when pricing estimates
items.description:
Project Operations calculates cost and sales estimates for resource assignments, including daily, time-phased estimates. These calculations can repeatedly use the same role-pricing information across assignments and dates.
With this feature enabled, Project Operations caches and reuses applicable role prices, markups, and price overrides within each estimate-pricing operation. This reduces repeated pricing lookups, helping improve responsiveness when calculating or updating estimates, particular

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Cancel actual from entry journals
items.description: The Entry Journal Actual Cancellation feature enables users to cancel actuals created by confirming entry journals. Users select eligible actuals, review them in a system-generated correction journal, and confirm the journal to create reversing actuals. The original actuals are marked Adjusted, preserving the original transactions and their reversal history rather than deleting them.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars in GCC High and DoD

Benefits
Reduce manual data entry when bringing information from external sources into Business Central.
Populate multiple relevant fields from copied content instead of copying and pasting individual values.
Extend AI-assisted data entry to more e

Selected addresses flow through the project lifecycle and are synchronized between Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Finance

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for Network Device Interface (NDI) Sources
items.description: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
items.description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
items.description: Two presenters can share a screen or window at the same time in a Teams meeting. Participants can see both shared content streams simultaneously, making it easier to compare and discuss content from different presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot Search Supports SharePoint Online Custom Properties Search
items.description: Discover and find people through Microsoft 365 Copilot Search based on your company's custom profile properties from SharePoint Online.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. Your profile enables features like voice isolation, speaker recognition, identification in a meeting room and transcripts, and enhanced meeting recaps and insights from Microsoft 365 Copilot. If you don’t yet have a voice profile, just go to the recognition tab in Teams settings and opt-in to enroll your voice from audio during your Teams meetings. Admins can enable or disable this feature.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Discover and act on recommended lead and opportunity actions in Sales agent

Sellers can discover and act on lead and opportunity recommendations that are already prioritized for them in Sales agent. A single prioritized list helps sellers see what needs attention without monitoring each agent separately or prioritizing the actions themselves. Sellers can review each recommended action, understand its details and business context, and take action from the same experience.
The initial release focuses on lead outreach actions from Sales qualification agent and opportunity
